Name: Low-noise encoding of active touch by layer 4 in the somatosensory cortex
Description: Data from a study investigating the precision of cortical spike trains during active tactile behavior in mice. Mice performed a whisker-based object localization task while recordings were made from excitatory neurons in layer 4 of the barrel cortex. The study shows that touch is the dominant sensorimotor feature, with the majority of spikes coupled to touch onset with millisecond temporal precision and low variability (eLife 2015; DOI: 10.7554/eLife.06619).
